newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia sugar refiner sees Dutch stake rising.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia sugar refiner sees Dutch stake rising.

text.p: Slovenian sugar refiner Tovarna sladkorja Ormoz d.d. said on Wednesday its Dutch shareholder Cosun would probably increase its stake to above the current 25 percent to a majority ownership.

"The Dutch company has some 25 percent of our company's shares, but after tommorow's news conference their plans and ownership will become clearer," Jurij Dogsa, Tovarna's general manager told Reuters.
He said Cosun would probably announce that it has increased its stake and may even attain a majority.

"There are a variety of scenarios that a majority foreign ownership brings about -- the darkest is that our company could be closed after two years. But I am optimistic over the future of our company," Dogsa said.
The company, listed on the over-the-counter section of the Ljubljana bourse, estimates its 1996 turnover increased to six billion tolars ($41.6 million) from four billion in 1995.
The company, however, sees 1996 profits dropping to around zero or below after two million tolars profit in 1995 due to stagnant sugar prices.
